longTrace.formula: For i from 0 through 360000: observationSeq=i; activeTimeUs=i*stepUs; xQ8=xQ8; yQ8=baseYQ8+(i%2)*oddYOffsetQ8. Mark first/last as start/stop. No capture sampling rate is implied.
longTrace.partition: source-driven; no timer flush; carry counts toward 512; close before span would exceed 250000us; finalize explicitly
longTrace.retentionReason: Every skipped alternating 4px interior observation exceeds 1.99px SED; all observations are retained. This expectation is independent of a production simplifier.
